Hi,

We’ve escalated this incident to our Security Team as a high‑severity (P1) case. They will preserve all relevant logs, immediately disable the former contractor’s account, and rotate any credentials that may have been exposed. Please retain any evidence you have (e.g., screenshots, export files) and avoid deleting logs or user data until we confirm the next steps.

Our Security Team will reach out within the next hour with further instructions. We’ll also keep your Customer Success Manager, Priya Nair, informed.

Thank you for reporting this promptly.

Best regards,
Support Team
